stock_cuda_image.target_rule: Read compute capability with nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap --format=csv,noheader; use that one target for SM_VERSIONS and -arch; require cuobjdump --list-elf to show matching code. Preserve -Xcompiler -fopenmp and -use_fast_math.

outputs.name: transforms
outputs.what: The rotation and translation fields of every ranked prediction row of the arm's docking.out (all fields of the row except the last), in file order.

outputs.name: scores
outputs.what: The score field (the last field) of every ranked prediction row of the arm's docking.out, in file order.

outputs.name: coords
outputs.what: The x, y and z coordinate columns of every ATOM and HETATM record of the arm's assembled models, models taken in rank order.

outputs.name: dockq
outputs.what: The evaluator's DockQ value for each of the arm's assembled models, as one JSON array in rank order, in a file that holds no other number.

metrics.name: wall
metrics.what: Trusted wall of the invocation: adapter and arm commands, plus the evaluator part.

scoring.reason: Brief explicitly says no published anchors exist for these inputs; no values or tolerances invented.

repeatability.seed_reason: No RNG seed specified by the brief/view; no stochastic seed invented.
repeatability.rules: A2 repeats A0 and A3 repeats A1 as separate invocations. Preserve files, failures and timeouts. No reruns outside pipeline schedule; no scale search.

A1.what: Seed configuration 2: the published MEGADOCK GPU build with the same sampling and scientific settings as A0, followed by the same reconstruction and assembly as A0.
commands: set -euo pipefail; for r in $(seq 1 50); do baseline-published/megadock/decoygen "lig_$r.pdb" "$2" "$0/docking.out" "$r" > "decoygen_$r.log" 2>&1; grep -v '^END' "$1" > "$0/model_$r.pdb"; grep -v -E '^(END|ENDMDL)' "lig_$r.pdb" >> "$0/model_$r.pdb"; echo END >> "$0/model_$r.pdb"; done

commands: set -euo pipefail; for r in $(seq 1 50); do baseline-published/megadock/decoygen "lig_$r.pdb" "$2" "$0/docking.out" "$r" > "decoygen_$r.log" 2>&1; grep -v '^END' "$1" > "$0/model_$r.pdb"; grep -v -E '^(END|ENDMDL)' "lig_$r.pdb" >> "$0/model_$r.pdb"; echo END >> "$0/model_$r.pdb"; done

evaluator.private_data: for each input, the native complex named in spec.reference, fetched by fetch_private.sh from its URL and checked against its SHA-256 and byte count
evaluator.reads: the model_<rank>.pdb files under CMP_ARM_OUT, in rank order
evaluator.invocation: BiotiteDockQ is constructed with parallel_io=False (models read in the evaluator's own process). The evaluator's Python code is a regular file kept in the harness and run by evaluate.sh as the venv interpreter followed by that file's path, never as a program read from standard input: PINDER's parallel reader starts its workers with the spawn method, which re-imports the main program from its file.
evaluator.writes: CMP_EVAL_OUT/dockq.json, one JSON array of the DockQ values in rank order and no other number; any per-model detail goes to a separate file under CMP_EVAL_OUT
evaluator.command_source: intake/brief.md, Comparison request, evaluator invocation correction
evaluator.command_status: Harness invocation specified by brief; not an upstream standalone script. The harness Python file is not supplied during intake.

api.native_chains: Map to receptor and ligand chains of the corresponding native complex; exact labels must be established by evaluator.

contract_limitations: This recording request contains no denser-search arm, no comparative tolerance and no quality summary. It cannot establish the original seed question about denser-search quality under a fixed spending cap. This is explicit scope, not a substituted experiment.
Only trusted invocation wall is a metric in the view. GPU activity, billed allocation cost and a total spending cap are not supplied. They cannot be claimed from this view.
Evaluator harness file and chain mapping implementation are specified but not supplied; execution preparation must implement them before paid work.
intake_deviation: Availability verification fetched native reference bytes over HTTPS to check size/hash outside fetch_private.sh. Payloads were discarded without structure parsing or scoring. This deviated from the brief's fetch-only boundary and is not an evaluation result.
